TLDR: It's not a game; it's an interactive mystery story with dialogue/action choices and the controls suck. The episodes are quite short (you can finish all 5 in a day easily) and the story is forgettable. You would be better off watching a YouTube video of it on 2x speed.

Pros:
Style-wise, it's a cross between Telltale Walking Dead and Fallout. I liked the visual style and detailed environments, they felt immersive to me. The story starts of well (mystery) and slowly unravels as you go through.

Cons:
While starting well, the story is ultimately completely forgettable. I say that because I actually played this game all the way though on another platform and had no lasting impression of it a few years later when I picked it out of my Steam Library as an "unplayed" game. I've played a fair few games in my time and I don't remember most of the contents of them, but I sure remember having played them or not. In combination with the atrocious control system (it's point and click but the camera angle pivots around all over the place, so you end up having to constantly reorient yourself and clicking in the wrong place and going backwards), I really can't recommend it.

   Сюжет и вот-это-поворот на сегодняшний день клишированные донельзя: ядерный апокалипсис, ковчеги с избранными, мутные типы. Но две временные линии вносят разнообразие.

   Идёт почти не провисая, персонажи с какими-никакими характерами, озвучены нормально. Головоломки по большей части простые. Кроме них геймплей состоит только в том, чтобы дойти куда-то, взять что-нибудь и с чем-нибудь соединить, + изредка простые qte. Исследования и коллекционирования нет, проработанных интерьеров и интерактивности почти нет.

   Игра линейная. В диалогах есть ограниченный по времени выбор, сомневаюсь, что он особо на что-то влияет, но, как минимум, можно потерять персонажей.

   Управление желейное, перемещение медленное, камера фиксированная, крутит как хочет, а ты иногда теряешься в направлении движения. Странное решение с кнопками взаимодействия, которые случайным образом меняются (на контроллере), и необходимостью при комментариях о предметах каждый раз нажимать кнопку "назад". Диалоги непропускаемые, но в этом не было особой потребности.

   Графика на данный момент не впечатляет, конечно, но стилизация делает её приемлемой. Анимаций практически нет, чего не скажешь о загрузках. Почему-то лок в 30 фпс.

   Итогом: этакий низкобюджетный, с несколько заезженным сюжетом не без глупости и пафоса [spoiler](что в итоге может даже повеселить)[/spoiler], но смотрибельный сериальчик на пару-тройку вечеров (моё итоговое время не показатель, продолжительность каждого эпизода прим. по часу).

Now that I've finally finished the game, here's a update to my previous review.

The story is exceptionally good and thought-provoking. Very exciting and not as predictable as you might think at first. 
Sometimes I was quite surprised. 

The graphics are a bit older and not the best, but that doesn't matter at all in this game. 
Nevertheless, the science fiction apocalyptic setting is extremely well designed with great attention to detail.

The voice acting and sound are great. 

The controls are point and click. Sometimes it's confusing when the camera angle changes. 
Most of the quick-time events are super easy, but some require at least a little effort – but everything is doable and not too challenging. And, of course, you have to make decisions during the dialogues that affect the rest of the game – sometimes you only have a limited amount of time to decide. 

I bought the game for €1.49, which was a really good bargain. It was definitely worth it and I was really well entertained overall. 

There are also negative points that really need to be considered.

Firstly, after completing the game for the first time, there is no option to skip the dialogues and cutscenes on the second playthrough.
This is so incredibly annoying and really stressed me out. 
The other thing that was really, really exhausting and frustrating was some of the achievements. I would never have managed it without the community guides. Thanks for that.

I'd like to give a tip here. 
Remember that you have 3 save slots available. 
My mistake was not using them properly. If you do it cleverly, you won't need as long as I did to get the achievements. And it's worth taking a look at the achievements list before starting each episode, because you don't want to have to restart the game over and over again like I did. I could have thrown up... I really wasted a lot of time. 

Overall, however, I am extremely satisfied.
You can see that the developers have put a lot of effort into it and have paid a lot of attention to detail and story. For an indie game, it's very well done. 

I would love to see more parts or a sequel, because these kinds of games are just great for playing in between other things. 

If you're looking for a simple game with a focus on story and don't care about anything else, then you should check it out. 
Buy it on sale, and you can't go wrong.

Please note, that i'll write the review for the whole game (including "The Descendant: Rest of Season") here. 
Though this package itself only contains a demo/trial-version (Episode 1). 

I sometimes check out Indie-games, since there can be real nice ones along. 
Glad, to tell you, that this is one of these times. 


If you install the game, start it and can't access anything, don't just rant about and uninstall it, like many others in the reviews. 
Try to either unplug any kind of gamecontroller, or just activate the Steam-Input for the game manually. 
Last thing worked for me, after i've read along the discussions, that removing gamecontrollers worked for others. 


The game: 

This game has Steam-achievements, which are - except for 4 of them - pretty easy to be done for an average person - though some require replaying chapters from certain episodes, especially if you failed at first attempt. 
It is preferrably played with a controller, since it contains some quicktime-events and the mouse-controls remind of good old 2D-Adventure-games, but unfortunately don't come in that handy on this 3D-Adventure-game. 

Once you played the game through, you just can copy the finished game to slot 2 or 3, and select 1 of these, replay the chapter of choice (e.g. to unlock missing achievements or see alternate endings) and either can delete it afterwards or just copy slot 1 again until you're done with the game. A very user-friendly way of handling savegames and making it possible, to test different approaches. 

There barely are any bugs afaik. 
I encountered 2 visual (beginning and end) and 1 functional bug (when shuffling cryopods) - only and really only - in Episode 5, else everything worked out smoothly. 


The story: 

The world has fallen by multiple missilie-encounters, only few "Chosen ones" remained and survived within Shelters - no, this is not Fallout. 

You start as Donald/"Donnie" - a former ARK-janitor - who's along a (former) politician on the quest, to open and recover ARK-01, which - for unknown reasons - hasn't opened yet. 

On your way in, you'll switch and also play Mia (one of the actual ARK's janitors), which - in a time-swapped version of the game - will pave the way for Donnie...the more or less. 

Decisions and efficiency matter a lot in this game, referring to progress and outcome. 
So be wise...


PRO: 
- low hardware-requirements; 
- nice visuals (kind of "Borderlands"-rendering for the outlinea, suitable like on "The Wolf Among Us"); 
- works fine with Playstation-controller (gamepad increases playability, mouse and keyboard feel a bit odd sometimes); 

CONTRA: 
- can't skip everything at any step, even if you reloaded or replay a chapter; 
- have to "play by the book", in order, to unlock accessibilities of items/interactions (e.g. check sth., to figure out, you need sth., which becomes accessable after that and not before already); 
- for some reason, the game seems to be used by bots (for trading Steam-cards) and scammers (referring to other reviews and mentionings among Steam's "discussions") but if you just install it, play it offline and go online to sync-savegames, you should be safe and sound - just in case, you're afraid of anything; 


So yeah, the game is nice. 
To convince yourself, you may install the free Episode 1 and if you like it, you can purchase the "The Descendant: Rest of Season"-DLC, and if you don't, just uninstall it - no offense, no harm taken. 

Even though the playtime is pretty low, referring to the quality and the storyline, the price seems to be ok, so probably you can't go wrong, buying it on a discount or in a bundle. 

Sad, that not more developers, offer such reasonable approaches, but beneficial to this one. 


P.S.: 
You can manually save your savegame, which commonly is located in "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\The Descendant\My Games" contained by the folder "The Descendant" by simply copying it to another folder or drive.

Non son un' appassionato d' Avventure Grafiche, The DeScendant lo collocherei in questo Variegato Insieme, e  aggiungo inoltre che, dalle prime impressioni, questo gioco non mi trasmetteva molto.
Tuttavia, sia perchè il primo Episodio è Gratis, sia per curiosità, ho deciso di provarlo.
E devo dire, che in corso d' opera, provando il primo Episodio, che alla fin fine la storia l' ho trovata molto intrigante, con i suoi misteri e plot che ti incuriosiscono, i Personaggi ( seppur non di uno spessore epocale ), che all' inizio trovavo anonimi, alla fine mi son piaciuti e mi ci son affezzionato.
E poi, vuoi per le musiche in alcuni punti ben curate, vuoi perchè l' atmosfera di questo gioco mi ha catturato, alla fine fine l' ho finito tutto in due giorni, e l' ho trovato decisamente gradevole e intrigante.
Va bene, a livello di telecamere si poteva far meglio, così come d' animazioni, però alla fin fine, con i suoi enigmi mai troppo complessi, e piacevoli da risolvere, la sua longevità per me azzeccatissima, il suo esser disposto ad Episodi ( stile Serie TV ) e il tutto che mi ha incuriosito sempre, per me The D. è una bella esperienza da provare, che consiglio :)

If you're expecting actual, point&click adventure style puzzles, you won't find them here.

Graphics are decent with nice atmospheric lighting. Game is capped to 30FPS by default (which makes the mouse pointer feel atrocious,) unless you unlock it manually through a registry edit (look it up on PC Gaming Wiki.) I ran it at 4K on a 4070 Ti Super and it stays locked to 60FPS 100% of the time, although GPU utilization is quite high for a game like this and of that age. It uses the Unity engine, so optimization is absolutely terrible. Back in 2016, so GPU could run this at 4K 60, which is why they locked it to 30. Fortunately now in 2024, it should be no problem.

There's one big technical problem though. The clicking is broken. More than half you clicks to move the character don't register. You constantly have to spam-click for the game to register the clicks. So this is a poin&click adventure game where the pointing&clicking is broken... Yeah. And they never fixed it.

But good effort overall. I enjoyed it, even if it seems it was made by people who don't really understand the genre. IMO, everyone who intends to create an adventure game should play Fate of Atlantis and Grim Fandango first to see what the peak of the genre is.

Когда то давно, кто то мне рекомендовал эту игру (если ЭТО можно назвать игрой). Проигнорировал тогда. И вот только недавно опять посоветовали, описали ее и я решил во что бы то не стало пройти ее. Такое резкое желание возникло из за похожести этого проекта с известной серией THE WALKING DEAD (TWD) практически во всем. Но с небольшой оговоркой... Это творение, которое годами было прямо под носом и совсем не замечалось мной мне понравилось куда больше чем TWD и я очень жалею, что был так недальновиден и разборчив в выборе. Очень глубокий и затягивающий сюжет с моментом загадочности всего происходящего на экране, выбором действий между героями и соответственно им последствий. Ядерная война испепелила города и те не многие уцелевшие люди укрылись в надежных подземных бункерах в замороженном виде в криокамерах в надежде в будущем через столетия проснутся из ледяного сна и попытаться восстановить уничтоженную жизнь на планете. Прошло 200 лет. Бункеры автоматически открылись и запустили процесс разморозки находящихся там людей. Кроме одного. И вот всю эту, извиняюсь за слово РОСКОШНО ПОСТАВЛЕННУЮ ТРАГЕДИЮ мы будем переживать и держать кулачки за двух инженеров смотрителей бункера которые 200 лет назад заперли за собой многотонные стальные ворота и двух спасателей которые спустя 200 лет после герметизации бункера подошли к огромной ржавой древней конструкции из железа и бетона с целью распечатать бункер, любой ценой попасть в его подземные глубины и узнать причину отказа открытия и разморозки людей, а возможно еще и куда более страшные тайны которые скрывают железобетонные недра холодного и мертвого подземного строения. Проект очень впечатлил и это не то слово... Визуально, это тот же VOXEL как и в TWD, только игра работает на UNITY. Смотрится изумительно. Огромная, очень сложная подземная махина нарисована до мельчайших подробностей. Это просто надо видеть какую титаническую работу проделали художники и дизайнеры что бы мы побывали в готовом и рабочем подземном строении и побывали же в нем спустя 200 лет когда оно пришло в полный упадок. Но зато эти 20 часов были сверх эмоциональны и напряженные. 20 часов невероятных событий приключений опасностей и конечно же личных, довольно интересных отношений друг к другу наших героев и их целей, тайн... и тяжестью грусти, обреченности потери близкого человека. Inwiefern unterschiedliche Entscheidungen tatsächlich den Verlauf grob ändern, kann ich noch nicht beurteilen. (Man kann falsche Entscheidungen treffen, die dann unmittelbar zum Tod führen, aber danach kann man fast an derselben Stelle nochmal von vorne beginnen. Das nervt also zumindest nicht). Die Click-to-run-Steuerung ist zeitweilig etwas nervig und hilft nicht wirklich bei der Orientierung. Allerdings kommt man durch Türen sowieso nur durch, wenn man auch alle Aufgaben im Raum erledigt hat. Großes Hin- und Hergelaufe wird einem also erspart. Ich habe es von vorne bis hinten in einem Zug durchgespielt und mich dabei nicht gelangweilt. Kann man also empfehlen.
Zur Story muss ich sagen: Das ein kleiner Teil der Menschheit das Ende der Welt in Bunkern überlebt, klingt sehr nach Fallout. Auch nicht neu ist der Fun-Fact,  dass man das Ende der Welt mit absolut fortschrittlicher Technik überlebt hat. Diese Technik wurde aber natürlich in Gebäuden erbaut, bei denen die Berufsgenossenschaft offensichtlich kein Mitspracherecht hat. Computer sind immer im obersten Stockwerk. Alle Aufzüge sind kaputt, aber man kann auch die rostige Leiter nebenan nehmen. Alle Türen sind mit Pincodes versehen, aber irgendjemand hat einen Zettel in die Nähe gelegt, auf dem der Code steht oder es gibt einen Lüftungsschacht der direkt und ohne Sicherung in den sicheren Bereich führt. Außerdem sind natürlich alle Geräte kaputt und die benötigten Ersatzteile und Werkzeuge liegen direkt daneben (Manchmal zusammen mit einer Leiche, von der man sich fragt, wie und wann die überhaupt dahin gekommen sein soll). Also alles, wie im echten Leben.  Der wahre Horror ist aber: Nachdem man das Ende der Welt überlebt hat, ausgerechnet mit einem Politiker eine Rettungsmission durchführen zu müssen. Das ist wirklich grausam.

Título do jogo: The Descendant
Plataformas: Microsoft Windows, macOS, Xbox One, PlayStation 4
Desenvolvedor: Gaming Corps AB
Ano de lançamento: 2016

The Descendant é um jogo de aventura e ficção científica dividido em episódios, desenvolvido pela Gaming Corps AB. A história se passa em um mundo pós-apocalíptico, onde os jogadores exploram uma instalação subterrânea conhecida como "Ark", projetada para abrigar a humanidade após um desastre global.

Visualmente, o jogo apresenta gráficos realistas e ambientes detalhados, que capturam a atmosfera sombria e desolada do cenário pós-apocalíptico. Os personagens também são bem-desenvolvidos, com animações e expressões faciais convincentes.

A trilha sonora de The Descendant é adequada, ajudando a criar uma atmosfera de suspense e mistério enquanto os jogadores exploram a instalação e desvendam sua história. Os efeitos sonoros contribuem para a imersão, com sons de ambiente e diálogos bem executados.

A jogabilidade de The Descendant é focada na exploração, resolução de quebra-cabeças e tomada de decisões. Os jogadores alternam entre dois personagens principais ao longo da história, interagindo com o ambiente, coletando pistas e descobrindo segredos ocultos no cenário pós-apocalíptico.

A narrativa é um dos pontos fortes do jogo, com uma história intrigante e cheia de reviravoltas. Através de flashbacks e eventos no presente, a trama revela lentamente os segredos da instalação "Ark" e dos personagens principais. As escolhas que os jogadores fazem ao longo da história também afetam o desenvolvimento da trama e o destino dos personagens, adicionando um elemento de ramificação à narrativa.

Uma das principais críticas ao jogo é a sua curta duração. Como um jogo dividido em episódios, cada episódio pode ser concluído em algumas horas, o que pode deixar os jogadores querendo mais quando a história termina.

Em resumo, The Descendant é uma experiência de aventura envolvente com uma história cativante e atmosfera pós-apocalíptica bem executada. Embora sua curta duração possa ser um ponto negativo, a narrativa intrigante e a jogabilidade de exploração e quebra-cabeças tornam o jogo uma escolha sólida para fãs de aventura e ficção científica.
